newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Negara meets the press on Tues on guidelines.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara meets the press on Tues on guidelines.

text.p: The Malaysian central bank said on Tuesday it was meeting the local and foreign media on Tuesday to clarify issues regarding its recently-issued guidelines on lending by financial institutions.
"There's no new guidelines. It's a clarification of the details," a Bank Negara Malaysia spokesperson told Reuters.
The meeting will start at 1000 local time (0200 GMT).
On Monday, the central bank met with the chief executive officers of financial institutions to discuss the curbs on loans for the property sector and for share buying.
Bank Negara has held a few round of discussions with bankers since issuing the guidelines at the release of its 1996 annual report on March 28.
